# hallpass_login_key (Resource)

A login key HallPass generates for a role or git access profile. The private key never leaves HallPass. Install `authorized_keys_line` on the server (or `public_key` on the git host, e.g. as a GitHub deploy key), then activate it with `hallpass_login_key_activation`. Destroying it revokes the key. To rotate, change `triggers` (create_before_destroy keeps the old key until the new one is active). Import with `<role_id>/<key_id>`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "hallpass_login_key" "web1_inspect" {
  role_id  = hallpass_role.web1_inspect.id
  triggers = { rotation = "2026-10" } # change to rotate

  lifecycle {
    create_before_destroy = true
  }
}

# Install authorized_keys_line on the server with your configuration management, for example:
output "web1_inspect_authorized_keys_line" {
  value = hallpass_login_key.web1_inspect.authorized_keys_line
}

# A git access profile's key goes to the git host, e.g. as a GitHub deploy key.
resource "hallpass_login_key" "acme_push" {
  role_id = hallpass_git_access_profile.acme_push.id
}

resource "github_repository_deploy_key" "api" {
  repository = "api"
  title      = "HallPass acme-push"
  key        = hallpass_login_key.acme_push.public_key
  read_only  = false
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `role_id` (String) Role or git access profile ID (`rol_…`). Changing it forces a new resource.

### Optional

- `triggers` (Map of String) Arbitrary values; changing any of them generates a new key (rotation).

### Read-Only

- `algorithm` (String) Key algorithm.
- `authorized_keys_line` (String) Line for the remote user's `~/.ssh/authorized_keys`, with `restrict` and `from="<gateway egress>"` options, plus `pty` when the role has that capability (so it changes when the role's capabilities do, and is refreshed on the next plan).
- `fingerprint` (String) SHA-256 fingerprint.
- `id` (String) Login key ID (`cred_…`).
- `public_key` (String) OpenSSH public key with a `hallpass:<server>/<role>` comment, for git hosts and other places that take a bare key.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# <role_id>/<login_key_id>
terraform import hallpass_login_key.web1_inspect rol_01m5qh1t09e4jbmeys0q0bjz8j/cred_01m5qh1t09e4jbmeys0q0bjz8k
```
